author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices the five-finger map, walk and run-ning rhythms, echo form, wave patterns, low left-hand notes and loud-soft echoes, with an old French carol.

classes.title: Five keys, five fingers
classes.goal: Map fingers 1 to 5 onto C to G and learn the first half.

mathTarget.parentLine: Finger numbers match key places: 1 on C, 5 on G

classes.parentPrompt: Say a finger number; your child wiggles that finger, then presses its key.
classes.childAction: Thumb on C. When you hear a number, press that finger's key.
classes.bridge: Five keys are five shepherds in a row; each finger looks after one.

intro.caption: Thumb on C, five in a row
intro.parentCue: call out finger numbers for your child

games.caption: Angels we have heard on high

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: matching finger numbers to keys.

classes.title: Walk, walk, run-ning Gloria
classes.goal: Learn the Gloria and feel walking notes change into run-ning notes.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two run-ning notes fit in the time of one walk

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'walk' on slow notes and 'run-ning' on quick ones while your child plays.
classes.childAction: Walk notes are slow; Gloria notes are run-ning. Play them both.
classes.bridge: Verse notes walk like shepherds; Gloria notes run like angels singing high.

intro.caption: Walk, walk, run-ning, run-ning
intro.parentCue: say it slowly, then pat it on your knees

games.caption: Hear the Gloria run
games.parentCue: Say 'run-ning' with each pair of lights

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: walk notes and run-ning notes.

classes.title: The mountains reply
classes.goal: Play the whole carol slowly and hear the verse lines echo each other.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two lines, then the same two again, then the Gloria

classes.parentPrompt: Cup your hands like a mountain echo when the first music comes back.
classes.childAction: Play slowly. When the same music comes back, say 'echo!'
classes.bridge: The angels sing two lines; the mountains sing them back; then everyone sings Gloria.

intro.caption: Listen for the echo
intro.parentCue: cup your hands when the music repeats

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing which parts repeat in a song.

classes.title: Gloria waves go down
classes.goal: Practise the Gloria waves slowly: each little wave starts a step lower.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same little wave, repeated a step lower each time

classes.parentPrompt: Draw small waves in the air going down the page as your child plays.
classes.childAction: Play E, D, C, D, then E, D, C. Waves rolling down.
classes.bridge: The Gloria rolls like waves down the hills to the left.

intro.caption: Little waves, rolling down
intro.parentCue: draw waves in the air, going lower

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a pattern repeating lower each time.

classes.title: Three low notes: C, F, G
classes.goal: Play one low left-hand note at the start of each bar and hear it change.

mathTarget.parentLine: The low note is always C, F or G; which one?

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune; say the low note's name, C, F or G, just before each bar.
classes.childAction: Left hand plays C, F or G at the start of each bar.
classes.bridge: Low notes live on the left: three fields where the shepherds stand.

intro.caption: Three low friends: C, F, G

games.caption: Home, away, further, home
games.parentCue: Name each low note as it lights

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: three low notes, C, F and G.

classes.title: Still below, busy above
classes.goal: Play the tune with one low note per bar: one hand holds, the other runs.

mathTarget.parentLine: One low note holds while eight quick notes run above

classes.parentPrompt: Rest a hand on your child's left shoulder and say 'hold' on each low note. Go slowly.
classes.childAction: Left hand holds still while the right hand runs the Gloria.
classes.bridge: Left hand is a still mountain; right hand is the singing that runs over it.

intro.caption: Two hands, two jobs
intro.parentCue: both hands on the keys, very slowly

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: two hands doing two different jobs.

classes.title: A little faster, together
classes.goal: Play both hands a little faster, and slow down again if notes fall apart.

mathTarget.parentLine: Same notes, same order, only the speed goes up

classes.parentPrompt: Tap a slightly faster beat on your knee; if notes fall apart, go back to slow.
classes.childAction: Play both hands a bit faster. Too fast? Slow down, no problem.
classes.bridge: The shepherds hurry a little across the plains, still on the same path.

intro.caption: A little faster, together
intro.parentCue: slow down any time it gets messy

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: the same music at a faster speed.

classes.title: Sing Gloria along
classes.goal: Play the whole carol along with the music at full speed and keep going.

mathTarget.parentLine: Fitting your playing to a speed you did not choose

classes.parentPrompt: Sing 'Gloria' beside your child; if notes are missed, keep going and smile.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music. Missed notes? Keep singing!
classes.bridge: People in France sang this carol long before anyone knew who wrote it.

intro.caption: Sing and play along
intro.parentCue: sing the Gloria softly beside your child

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping up with the music.

classes.title: Echo concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the carol for teddy: lines strong, echoes soft, then a bright Gloria.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same music, first strong, then soft like an echo

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; whisper 'echo' before the soft lines, then cheer at the end.
classes.childAction: Play strong, then soft for the echo, then a bright Gloria.
classes.bridge: The angels sing strong up high; the mountains answer soft and far away.

intro.caption: A carol for teddy!
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing strong and soft, a whole song.
